decision.observation: Reverse backed the car out cleanly: 4 mph in gear R, sitting on open grass just left of the lane with pines behind and to the left. The tarmac with blue puddles and its white post line runs up-screen on the right, curving right past a heap of barrels. Red X still lit, all dots dark.
decision.hypothesis: The car is clear of trunks now with only a small gap to the lane, so a short forward right-steer should put it on the tarmac without punching back into the pine line.
decision.memory: Long W+D holds here have driven into pines; 0.4s corrections are the safer size on this verge. Plain S freed the car twice in a row.
